findings.passage: I am adamantly opposed to ending the filibuster. This is the sixty-vote threshold needed in the Senate to pass legislation.
findings.note: From her campaign blog recap of a Senate primary candidate forum. The question 5 she recaps (in her words, 'Question five was about the SAVE Act and the candidates’ willingness to eliminate the filibuster in order to pass it.') was about ending the filibuster to pass the SAVE Act. She states her view on the filibuster. She does not state a view on the SAVE Act's proof-of-citizenship content.
